subject: irish
summary: Short-answer cards (reading comprehension and listening) look deliberate: each sub-question gets its own box with accepted answers as tickable rows and a clear mark. The long-answer cards are the weak point: the composition scheme is a wall of small grey text in which the SEC grade table has been flattened into one paragraph with a row of dashes, and the essay cards (Cáca Milis HL, Gafa) show no marking guidance at all, only the question repeated three times above a grid of 26-36 mark buttons. Multi-part reading questions are printed as one run-on paragraph ('3 (a) ... (3 mharc) (b) ...'). Attached pages are correct for reading passages, but for listening and prose cards the attachment is just the question page and shows other questions (other news pieces, Ceist 10(b)/11, the (a) parts of the same question) and is mislabelled 'source text'. Every listening card shows 'The embedded recording could not be loaded'.

issues.title: Grade tables and band descriptors flattened into run-on paragraphs
issues.detail: The SEC grade grids are pasted as continuous grey text. Card 1 'Cumas Gaeilge' reads 'Aicme (1) Stór Gaeilge (2) Beachtas / Cruinnúsáid Grád Grád Raon ------------- A (1) Fairsingeacht agus Saibhreas A ard 76-80 marc an-mhaith ar fad / sármhaith A meánach 72-75 ...' with a literal row of dashes; 'Ionramháil Ábhair' reads 'Aicme Grád Marc Ionramháil shármhaith ... A 13, 14, 15 Ionramháil an-mhaith B 11, 12 ...'. The 5-mark 'Gaeilge' descriptor on cards 2, 7 and 10 runs the five bands together ('... deilbhíocht) 5 Cumas an-mhaith ... 4 Cumas maith ...'), and card 2's 'Catagóir Plé (11 mharc) Marcanna Sármhaith ... 10-11 An-mhaith ... 8-9' is the same. On the phone the composition scheme is roughly two and a half screens of unbroken small text.
issues.suggested_fix: Render each band grid as a real table (grade / description / mark range), or show a crop of the official scheme table as an image; put the band next to the matching mark button. Split the composition guidance into short headed blocks.

issues.title: Essay cards have no scheme content, only the question repeated
issues.detail: On the 30-mark and 40-mark literature essays the 'Eolas' box is tagged 'Possible directions - not a checklist' but lists no directions. The full question text appears three times (in the question, as the box heading, and again as the row label) followed by a grid of 0m-25m or 0m-35m buttons. A student learns nothing about what earns the marks. On desktop the repeated question is squeezed into a narrow column beside the button grid.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the scheme's indicative points for the essay (or say plainly that the SEC prints none and give the band descriptors as a table). Do not repeat the question as a row label; replace the long button grid with a slider or band picker.

issues.title: Attached page shows other questions
issues.detail: Where the card is not a reading passage, the attachment is the raw question page. Card 6 (Píosa a Trí) opens on Píosa a hAon and Píosa a Dó with their questions; card 9 (Ceist 10(a)) shows Ceist 10(b), 11(a) and 11(b) in full; card 3 ((b)(i)) opens on parts (a)(i)/(ii) for three different texts; card 8 also shows the An Lasair Choille alternative; card 12 also shows An Dara Mír question 1. All are labelled 'SOURCE TEXT' and 'exact examination text', which is misleading because there is no source text, and the card already prints the same question as text.
issues.suggested_fix: Crop the attachment to this question only, or drop the attachment on cards whose question is fully typed. Reserve the 'source text' label for actual passages.

issues.title: Multi-part questions run together in one paragraph
issues.detail: Reading-comprehension questions with parts (a), (b), (i), (ii) are printed as one paragraph with the part labels and marks inline: '3 (a) Luaigh ... (Alt 3) (3 mharc) (b) Luaigh dhá thréith ...'. Card 11 has four prompts in one block. Cards 2 and 8 show the same kind of content correctly as a labelled list, so the app is inconsistent.
issues.suggested_fix: Break each part onto its own line with the label in the margin and the marks right-aligned, as cards 2 and 8 already do.

issues.title: Raw examiner shorthand and merged answers in answer rows
issues.detail: Card 4 has an answer row reading 'Is dócha go bhfuil tréithe eile intuigthe/inghlachta........inspioráideach.... "spiorad na saoirse"iontu......láidir....cróga....tírghrách......' with dot leaders and missing spaces, 'naPolainne', and two answer rows worth '0m' with no explanation. Card 12 question 2 puts five separate acceptable points in one tick box as one sentence ('Is ball den chlub rothaíochta é sin, Eoin. Bunaíodh an club an samhradh seo caite Tá dhá chéad ball ...').
issues.suggested_fix: Split alternatives into one row each, replace dot leaders with a list of the other accepted traits, and label 0-mark rows as 'not accepted'.

issues.title: Empty tariff header and repeated boilerplate
issues.detail: Cards 3 and 9 show an answer box whose heading is blank except for a stray mark pill ('20m', '10m'). Card 8 repeats the same four-line examiner note under each of five sub-parts, which pushes the phone card to three columns; in part (i) the only sample answer ('Caithfidh sí dul go dtí an leithreas') sits inside the examiner note instead of a sample-answers box. Card 3's task check lists whole-paper instructions ('Tá rogha ann idir an Cúrsa Ainmnithe (leathanach 2) agus an Cúrsa Roghnach (leathanach 6)') that do not belong to this part. The deduction buttons start at '-0'.
issues.suggested_fix: Hide the empty heading row, show the shared examiner note once per card, and limit the task check to this part.

issues.title: Stray orange underlines and audio not loading
issues.detail: Orange underlines appear on some lines of the question and not others with no visible meaning: on card 2 parts (ii) and (iii) are underlined but (i) is not; on cards 7 and 8 the instruction line is underlined rather than the question; on card 10 the underline stops mid-sentence. Every listening card shows 'The embedded recording could not be loaded' with a 0:00 player (may be a capture-environment fault).
issues.suggested_fix: Underline only the command phrase consistently or remove it; check the audio embed on a real device.

good_examples.why: Two parts, each with its own box, short accepted answers as tick rows and a clear 5-mark tariff.
Listening questions listed 1-3 and the scheme mirrors them with full and partial-credit answers per row.
Scheme is clean and per-part with '1 ceart 2m, 2 ceart 3m' tariffs; passage attachment is the right one.
